data.one_liner: Widget that hides its child and shows a loading animation until data is ready
data.what_it_does: Provides two widgets, WiperLoading and CircularWidgetLoading, that display a customizable loading animation while a child widget is not yet available. They can be used with a boolean flag or a Future to automatically hide/show the child.
use_when: You need a quick loading placeholder for a widget
You want a simple, customizable loading animation without writing custom code
You prefer a declarative API that works with Future or a loading flag
avoid_when: You need complex or highly customized loading animations
You require advanced state management or integration with other packages
strengths: Supports both flag and Future usage
weaknesses: No advanced features like skeleton screens or shimmer effects
Not suitable for complex UI states

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a shimmer effect for loading placeholders, which can be a more visually appealing alternative for some use cases
